name: Status
layerWhy: It says how one thing stands; no job.
promise: This is fine, needs attention, has stopped, hasn't started, or is under way.
expectation: A mark and a word at the end of a row, saying how that row stands.
evidence: The mark's shape says the state (dot, triangle, square, ring, half), the word says it fully, the colour only adds.
behaviour: Five states, each with its own shape.
context: Records with a state: invoices, members, jobs.
accessibility: The word is the accessible text; the mark is decoration.
dont: A status dot with no word.
